title: Guidance on three channels
goal:
DiT predicts both noise and a diagonal covariance, so its output has $2C$ channels: the first $C$ are $\epsilon$ and the last $C$ are the covariance (Section 3.2, "Transformer decoder"). Classifier-free guidance (Section 3.1) is $\hat\epsilon = \epsilon(x_t, \varnothing) + s \cdot (\epsilon(x_t, c) - \epsilon(x_t, \varnothing))$. Appendix A says the authors applied guidance only to the first three channels of the latent, not all four.

Write `guided_output(out_cond, out_uncond, s, C=4, n_guided=3)`. Both inputs have shape `(2*C, H, W)`. Return an array of shape `(2*C, H, W)` whose first `n_guided` channels hold the guided noise, whose remaining noise channels (up to `C`) copy the conditional pass, and whose covariance channels (`C` onward) copy the conditional pass.
hints: Start from `out = out_cond.copy()`, then overwrite only `out[:n_guided]`.
With `s = 1` the guided noise equals the conditional noise. Use that to check your formula.
Do not guide the covariance channels. The formula in Section 3.1 is for $\epsilon$ only.
